scope: Six actual keyboard/gamepad door crossings and physical exits; three domestic plans, three civic rooms and existing dialogues, pause and one mobile domestic view. No teleportation or real user saves. Geometry coverage is separately43 rooms.

deployment.confirmation: Release owner confirmed Vercel READY before these fresh browser recipes.

observations: Public port renders continuous terrain, native shuttle and facade layers without the previous orbital floor label.
Homeworld Navigation and Pause are unobscured by the global header.
Mobile movement controls stay within393x852; the full south exit text is visible.
Mausoleum NPC, console and player ground contacts match the reviewed local composition.
limitations: Six sampled physical room visits, not a browser traversal of all43 rooms. Separate geometry tests cover43.
Synthetic adult fixture owns no trophies, so dynamic owned-trophy wall displays are not visually certified here.

infrastructureNote: An initial sandbox attempt was denied network access before page load; rerun used the explicit scoped network permission. That infrastructure refusal is not a gameplay failure.
